_note: Phase 1D-C3 SPECIFICATION -- extends configs/era5_request.json with surface_solar_radiation_downwards (6th variable required for weather-aware v2 dataset). Original era5_request.json is UNTOUCHED; 2020 5-var monthly files remain valid and are supplemented by ssrd-only files (request_YYYY_MM_ssrd.json). Authority: task directive 2026-09-26 + docs/PHASE1B_WEATHER_DESIGN.md.
extends: configs/era5_request.json (same bbox, years, months, days, hours, format)
product: reanalysis (ERA5 hourly data on single levels)

variable_notes.relative_humidity: NOT a native ERA5 single-level variable -- derived from 2m_temperature + 2m_dewpoint_temperature via Magnus formula at aggregation time (documented in WEATHER_CARD derivation log)
variable_notes.10m_wind_speed: derived as sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2) from u/v components at aggregation time
variable_notes.surface_solar_radiation_downwards: NATIVE ERA5 accumulated variable (J/m^2 accumulated since 00:00 UTC each day). Hourly mean W/m^2 = max(0, ssrd(t)-ssrd(t-1h))/3600; midnight-reset diff clips to 0 (nighttime, negligible error). De-accumulation documented in scripts/process_era5.py.
variable_notes.total_cloud_cover: NATIVE ERA5 units are PERCENT (0-100). Normalised to 0-1 fraction at aggregation time (divide by 100). Verified against raw value range during processing.

time_note: 00:00-23:00 UTC hourly (ERA5 native). Tail extension to 2026-01-01 04:00 UTC required to cover PJM test end (see docs/ERA5_ACQUISITION_CARD.md section 4).

area.strategy: PJM bounding box (Option A) + 0.25deg rim, snapped outward to ERA5 grid (Option B buffer rule, docs/PJM_BBOX_CARD.md section 4)

acquisition_modes.full_5var: monthly/era5_pjm_<year>_<month>.nc for 2021-2025 with the 5 instantaneous variables (proven 2020 pattern; executed via scripts/download_era5_batch.py --mode full)
acquisition_modes.ssrd_supplement: monthly/era5_pjm_<year>_<month>_ssrd.nc for 2020-2025 (ssrd only; merged with 5-var files at processing time, raw files untouched; executed via --mode ssrd). Rationale 2026-09-26: mixed instantaneous+accumulated CDS requests returned unreadable payloads (2021-01..03 quarantined, see batch_download_log.jsonl), so ssrd is always pulled separately.
acquisition_modes.deprecated_6var_single_request: ABANDONED 2026-09-26 after 2021-01..03 unreadable-payload failures. Do not use.
